archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST DATA
theme: Dark and Light Mode toggle via next-themes / local state, default dark for sleek financial command center

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

visual_enhancers.subtle_borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) in dark, 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) in light

layout_strategy.grid_mode: High Density Bento Grid for Financial Analytics
layout_strategy.responsive_sidebar: Collapsible sidebar / bottom nav bar on mobile viewports

key_features_architecture.storage: Local-first IndexedDB (via Dexie.js or custom IndexedDB wrapper) with auto-save & JSON/CSV import/export
key_features_architecture.multi_currency: Real-time & offline exchange rates support (IDR primary, USD, EUR, SGD, MYR, JPY, AUD) with dynamic rate overrides
key_features_architecture.bilingual: Toggle ID (Bahasa Indonesia) / EN (English) stored in local preferences
key_features_architecture.accounts_and_sources: Debit cards, Credit cards, E-Wallets (Gopay, OVO, Dana, ShopeePay), Cash, Investments with custom dynamic badges and validation
key_features_architecture.expense_income_entry: Manual transaction logger with dynamic category dropdowns, tag selector, receipt image attachment, and OCR scan simulation/parser
key_features_architecture.bills_and_installments: Recurring bill tracker & PayLater / Spinjam installment manager (e.g. Shopee PayLater 3/6/12x, PLN Token, Wifi, Kost, Parent allowance) with dynamic remaining installment count & price edits
key_features_architecture.debts_and_receivables: Utang & Piutang module with payment logs, due date alerts, browser notifications, and WhatsApp reminder link generator
key_features_architecture.savings_celengan: Savings goals with target date, visual progress ring, target allocation from accounts, and milestone badges
key_features_architecture.wishlist: Item wishlist with priority tag, target URL, price, savings connection, and 'Buy Now / Converted to Expense' workflow
key_features_architecture.historical_comparison: Side-by-side month-over-month (MoM) and week-over-week (WoW) comparison down to category level and individual item level
key_features_architecture.export_reports: CSV export, JSON backup, printable PDF financial summary generated client-side
key_features_architecture.gmail_and_notifications: Gmail OAuth 2.0 integration UI/Setup guide + simulated e-banking email notification parser (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, GoPay, OVO) for zero-backend security
key_features_architecture.scheduler_and_reminders: Client-side daily/weekly/monthly email report scheduler (Webhook/Mailto integration option) + local Browser Notification reminders

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade, highly responsive local-first personal financial management web app in TypeScript/React.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='add-transaction-button').
Implement bilingual translations (ID/EN) across all UI elements, labels, placehholders, charts, and export documents.

Ensure all data persists in local storage (IndexedDB) with pre-populated realistic Indonesian demo data (Gopay, BCA Debit, ShopeePayLater, Kost, PLN, Jajan, etc.) so the app is instantly rich upon first load.
Implement full filter/sort options across transactions (by date, category, account, type, tag, amount range).
Support Recharts interactive charts (Bar chart for category comparisons, Area chart for net worth growth, Donut chart for spending allocation).
Ensure complete responsive layout supporting mobile screens, tablets, and wide desktop displays with light and dark mode.
Integrate Shadcn primitives (Dialog, Select, Tabs, Popover, Calendar, Table, Badge, Button, Input) with custom styling.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or floating headers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner toast notifications for feedback on save, edit, delete, export, and reminder actions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.micro_interactions: Add hover states, subtle scaling, and smooth motion transitions to cards and action buttons.
